issue.original_range: 0 <= j <= m-1 with target EXISTS q_{j+1} F_j IFF F_{j+1}
issue.problem: At j=m-1, F_{m-1}=(q_0 OR q_m) and EXISTS q_m F_{m-1} is TRUE; F_m was not defined. Therefore the stated recurrence step cannot include j=m-1.

canonical_corrected_domain.F_j_definition: F_j := (q_0 OR q_{j+1}) AND AND_{i=j+1}^{m-1} ((NOT q_i) OR q_{i+1}), for 0<=j<=m-1
canonical_corrected_domain.terminal_projection: EXISTS q_1...q_{m-1} F_0 IFF F_{m-1} IFF (q_0 OR q_m)
